info.title: Billflow API
info.description: Multi-tenant billing API. Send the Supabase access token as a Bearer token. Row level security isolates tenants. JSON fields are snake_case.

api_secret.description: Write-only. Empty keeps the current secret. Null clears it.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Becomes the public site subdomain.

unit_price.description: Tax-exclusive unit price in the invoice currency.

tax_rate_id.description: Catalog tax rate. When set, the stored percent comes from tax_rates.

tax_rate.description: GST percent used when tax_rate_id is omitted.

discount.description: Tax-exclusive discount in rupees. Totals are computed on the server.

amount_tendered.description: Cash handed over by the customer.

change_given.description: Cash handed back. Omit to use tendered minus the amount due.

amount.description: Amount to collect. Defaults to the outstanding balance.

secret.description: At least 16 characters. Generated when omitted.
